# EnglEuphoria

> Live 1-on-1 English lessons with expert teachers, across three hubs:
> Playground (kids 5-12), Academy (teens 13-17), and Success (adults 18+).
> CEFR-aligned curriculum, real teachers, no group classes.

- [Pricing](https://www.engleuphoria.com/pricing.md): plan names, prices, and what's included, in plain text
- [Pricing page](https://www.engleuphoria.com/pricing): the same plans, rendered
- [Methodology](https://www.engleuphoria.com/methodology): teaching approach and CEFR alignment
- [For Teachers](https://www.engleuphoria.com/for-teachers): joining as a teacher
- [About](https://www.engleuphoria.com/about): company background
- [Playground demo](https://www.engleuphoria.com/playground-demo): kids hub preview
- [Academy demo](https://www.engleuphoria.com/academy-demo): teens hub preview
- [Success demo](https://www.engleuphoria.com/success-demo): adults hub preview
